title: Same Trade, Different Results: Why Some Businesses Break Through and Others Never Do
dek: Two pool companies do the same work in the same market. One keeps growing and the other stalls. The difference lives inside the owner.
description: Jeff Boyer on why businesses in the same industry succeed or stall: the size of the owner's vision and complete dedication to making it real.

title: I Wrote the 6 Pillars. Reading Them Again Showed Me Where I've Drifted.
dek: I'm always working on these pillars. But going back and reading them with honest eyes showed me where my life needs recalibrating, and why every man needs to keep checking himself.
description: Jeff Boyer on rereading the BILD 6 Pillars, finding where he's out of alignment, and a simple honest check-in any man can use to recalibrate.

title: The Test Hidden in Every Blessing
dek: I've been given more than I ever imagined. Every blessing came from stepping out in faith, and every one carried a challenge that forced me to grow closer to God.
description: Jeff Boyer on building a pool business from nothing, expanding to Dallas, and why every blessing that comes from faith carries a test of its own.

title: The Grandmother Who Saw a Missionary in Me
dek: She kept telling me I'd serve a mission, and I kept telling myself I wouldn't. She never got to see her words come true. But they did.
description: Jeff Boyer on his grandmother's belief in him, the night she passed, and how a mission to Brooklyn he never wanted became one of the greatest gifts of his life.

title: Three Bombs and a No-No: The Day I Still Stand On
dek: In 1995 I threw a no-hitter and hit three home runs in the same game. It took me years, a hard confession, and one night of prayer to understand what that day was really for.
description: Jeff Boyer on his miracle baseball game in 1995, the years he drifted from God, telling the truth at 21, and the foundation BILD is built on.

title: The $500,000 Check I Wrote Myself at My Lowest Point
dek: In 2010 I was scraping by and thinking about leaving California. What changed things had less to do with strategy and more to do with what I finally let myself see.
description: Jeff Boyer on losing his house in 2009, writing himself a $500,000 check, and what faith and imagination have to do with building a life.
